# CyberBuddy

> Browser security assessment suite: clickjacking validation, security header grading (A–F / 0–100), CSP policy auditing, and CORS posture checks with evidence-grade output.

- Hub: https://amitpal-cyberbuddy.github.io/CyberBuddy/
- Methodology: https://amitpal-cyberbuddy.github.io/CyberBuddy/#methodology
- Source: https://github.com/AmitPal-CyberBuddy/CyberBuddy
- Author: Amit Pal — https://amitpxl.medium.com/ · https://www.linkedin.com/in/amitpal-wb/
- Contact: amitpal.secure@gmail.com
- Disclosure: https://amitpal-cyberbuddy.github.io/CyberBuddy/.well-known/security.txt
- License: Apache-2.0

## Tools

- Clickjacking Validator (`/tools/clickjacking/`) — X-Frame-Options + CSP frame-ancestors + live iframe proof. OWASP WSTG-CLNT-09, CWE-1021.
- Security Headers (`/tools/headers/`) — CSP, HSTS, XFO, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/COEP/CORP, cookie flags. OWASP WSTG-CONF-07/12, CWE-693.
- CORS Validator (`/tools/cors/`) — ACAO reflection vs allowlist, credentials, Vary: Origin. OWASP WSTG-CLNT-07, CWE-942.
- CSP Policy Auditor (`/tools/csp/`) — enforced vs Report-Only CSP, effective script/style sources, navigation controls, mixed content, syntax, Trusted Types, and reporting. OWASP WSTG-CONF-12, CWE-79, CWE-693.

## How scans run

1. Python engines (`server.py` or optional Vercel `api/`) when reachable.
2. Same-origin published reports at `cache/<host>.json` for the demo targets listed in `urls.txt` (GitHub Actions, every 6 hours).
3. In-browser graders, a direct CORS read, then opt-in third-party header relays. All checks are read-only GETs.

## Constraints

Authorized testing only. Do not scan systems without permission. Results are advisory, never a guarantee of safety. Cloud-metadata and link-local targets are always blocked.

## Privacy

Scan history is stored only in the user's browser (localStorage, 24h expiry); it is never uploaded and never shared between users. Published reports cover only the fixed demo targets in urls.txt, never user-submitted URLs. Third-party header relays (hackertarget.com, allorigins.win, corsproxy.io, codetabs.com) are opt-in, receive the hostname only by default, and their results are labelled unverified.
